description: This file defines a class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Impulse' which extends 'Image_Graph_Plot' to implement an impulse chart plotting in the Image_Graph PEAR package. It includes methods for drawing legend samples and rendering the impulse plot on a canvas, utilizing dataset points and handling stacking and axis scaling.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Impulse
classes.description: A class for rendering impulse charts as part of the PEAR Image_Graph package. It handles the drawing of impulse data points and legend representation, extending base plotting capabilities.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the impulse plot in the legend area, centered at the provided x-coordinates, as a vertical line.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the impulse plot on the canvas, handling stacking, axis scaling, and line drawing for each dataset point, and manages grouping and clipping for rendering.
